item.title: Same Model, Different Answer: What System Prompts Actually Do
item.description: I asked three Claude interfaces the same prompt injection question. One gave me a full strategy guide. The other two drew the line at explanation. Same model — completely different behavior. Here’s what that reveals.

item.title: Prompt Injection: Hijack LLM Instructions
item.description: I started a Hack The Box AI security lab with zero expectations. Three minutes later, I had leaked a secret key the model had been explicitly told never to reveal. Here’s what I learned — and why it matters if you build with LLMs.
